findings.description: The policy grants the deployment IAM user ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, and cloudwatch:* on every resource. This provides broad data access and infrastructure-control capabilities well beyond least privilege, including creating or modifying resources and Lambda functions.

The encrypted IAM access-key secret is exposed through a Terraform output that is not marked sensitive. Although encrypted, the ciphertext can be displayed to output consumers and may be decryptable by principals with access to the applicable decryption key; it is also retained in Terraform state.
